thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT — PagerDuty incident created for service `inference-gateway-prod` (ap-southeast1). Metric: 5xx_rate > 6% over 2m. pd_incident: INC-23791

alice.nguyen: seeing a big bump in 502/504s, looks correlated with a canary rollout to ap-southeast1 (canary-2026-03-15). Latency also up ~200ms. Not sure if it's upstream or our side. graphs: https://grafana.redwood/infer/gw

sam.kapoor: i'm oncall, taking the page. acked in PD. @pagerduty confirmed ACK by sam.kapoor :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: Incident INC-23791 acknowledged by sam.kapoor at 2026-03-15T04:20Z.

oncall-sre: quick check — origin logs show a surge of `net/http: connection reset by peer` from the canary nodes. Also a small spike in 429s from backend KV cache.

benji: marking customer impact as "partial degradation" until we know more. A few downstream customers reported retries. gonna notify cs for possible customer pings.

lisa-platform: rolling back canary seems safest. if it's a bad kernel/driver combo on the new build, we should stop it. +1 to rollback.

sam.kapoor: agree. starting rollback now. command: ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway --to-revision=canary-2026-03-14 || true```

ops-bot: Runbook step triggered: "canary rollback" executed by sam.kapoor.

alice.nguyen: already seeing error rate drop a bit after initiating. 5xx rate down to 3.8% in ap-southeast1.

sam.kapoor: scaling up stable pool while rollback completes, to reduce throttling pressure. command: ```kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-stable --replicas=12``` 

oncall-sre: also bumping circuit-breaker thresholds on edge to avoid aggressive fail-open. Adjusting proxy config: `retry: 1 -> 2`, `timeout: 15s -> 20s` for region ap-southeast1.

pagerbot: :information_source: Temporary routing rule applied: 25% of new traffic in ap-southeast1 redirected to eu-west1 for background workloads. rule-id: route-ps-17665

alice.nguyen: note — prefix cache warmed on eu-west1 already, should be fine for short bursts.

benji: CS notified and posting status page update in 5m: "We are investigating increased error rates in ap-southeast1; mitigation in progress."

sam.kapoor: rollback completed, canary pods terminated. verifying health checks... health is green across stable nodes. 5xx now 1.2% and trending down.

oncall-sre: running quick smoke: `curl -v https://ap-south-east.inference.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` returns 200 and sample response. looks good.

lisa-platform: creating a temporary autoscale policy to bring more headroom for the next 2 hours.

ops-bot: Autoscale policy `temp-headroom-apse1` applied: min=8, max=16, cooldown=60s.

sam.kapoor: assigning post-incident tasks: - investigate canary build changes (kernel bump + new MKL) - run extra kv-cache load tests - confirm if any client retries caused user-visible duplication. I'll open a tracking ticket: IR-23791.

alice.nguyen: will collect logs and representative traces and drop into the ticket. also taking a heap of pprof samples from the canary cluster nodes for offline analysis.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-23791 resolved (mitigated) by sam.kapoor. Resolution note: canary rollback + scale up stable pool + temporary routing mitigation.

benji: leaving the followup ownership with platform (lisa-platform) and reliability (alice.nguyen). CS will do customer outreach for any affected accounts.

lisa-platform: acknowledged handoff. i'll schedule a deeper postmortem and coord with infra to run durability tests on the canary artifact.

sam.kapoor: final note: no full outages detected, partial degradation only; keeping rotation on watch for 2 hours. logging the timeline and starting a postmortem doc. thanks all for quick action. :bow:

ops-bot: Next oncall rotation in 6h — reminder to oncall that monitoring alert thresholds may be tuned after postmortem.

alice.nguyen: adding links: alert graph: https://grafana.redwood/alert/INC-23791  rollback job logs: https://logs.redwood/rollback/17665  postmortem: https://docs.redwood/ir/IR-23791

sam.kapoor: closing thread here, will ping once postmortem draft is ready.
